# Replica Test , click through every flow of an app clone and find the bugs

Curated by Skill Harbor: the QA step of the 11-skill Replica pack: click through every flow of an app clone and test it for bugs. It generates a test plan from the recon flows with numbered cases (happy paths, edge cases like double-click submit and expired sessions, negative cases like declined cards), automates what it can with Playwright (roles and labels for selectors, axe accessibility scans), click-throughs the rest by hand, and files every reproduced bug in a fixed format with severity. by @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: one hard rule, test your clone, never the original (no load testing or hammering someone else's servers); pairs with replica-build, reads the flows from the recon map. Ship nothing with an open S1. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via GitHub.
